title: Session 3 functional checks (agent slot, hidden desktop, NOT timing): d0t = devoff2 + REX_TIMER_WAIT_BLOCKING=1 (Agent 11) next to d0f = devoff2
notes: Agent 11's d0t check (OK'd by Agent 1): pass = TimerQueue busy <= ~3 % in threads.csv (window 3 d0: 62 %), no more > 100 ms frames than d0f, a clean close, no dump. d0f runs right before with the same settings, so the pair compares like for like. Window: 5 s settle + 35 s warm-up asked, raised to 55 s by the 60 s first-frame floor (min_window_after_ff_s default, as in window 4), then 50 s measured; window 3's d0 had no floor (35 s warm-up). TimerQueue busy % is a per-thread share, so the longer warm-up does not change the pass rule. Functional only (hidden desktop): the frame numbers are not timing.
REX_TIMER_WAIT_BLOCKING must reach the game process: run-timing.ps1 sets it in its own environment around Start-Process and restores it after; run.json env_set shows it. Any value turns it on.

arms.note: devoff2 as window 3's d0: functional reference for d0t
devoff2 + REX_TIMER_WAIT_BLOCKING=1: TimerQueue blocking wait, no rebuild (Agent 11)
